pages.heading: Murmur
pages.body: Very deep caves, rarely Cherry Groves. Its long neck lets it attack from far away; hits to the head deal reduced damage. Elastic Tendons make a Tendon Whip with

pages.heading: Murmur (cont.)
pages.body: Dropbear Claws. The rare Unsettling Kimono adds placement reach and reduces attention from many undead, but not Murmurs or the Wither.
